# Use the top-level folder popup as the Spam Settings selection receiver

Folder menus copy their oncommand attribute into generated submenus. onActionTargetChange now ignores copied invocations unless currentTarget has the expected top-level popup ID. It takes the chosen folder from target._folder, writes the matching Account/Folder preference and invokes selectFolder on currentTarget. The previous hard-coded actionFolderPopup updated the wrong visible picker for Account selections. Keep the clicked folder and popup receiver separate; no live event, accessibility or account-settings run was performed.

Scope: Account Manager Spam Settings folder controls.
